title: 20-yr-old army officer's son dies after car falls into open drain in south Delhi
content: Tragedy struck Vasant Kunj when a 20-year-old student named Yashvendra lost his life after his car rolled into an open drain. Having just returned from the United States, he was accompanied by a woman who managed to escape unharmed. Poor road conditions, exacerbated by recent rainfall, caused the car to skid. The police later retrieved both the vehicle and Yashvendra's body from the drain.

title: CJP protest: 18 Delhi metro stations remain shut; heavy security at Jantar Mantar
content: Delhi Metro restrictions will continue for the fourth consecutive day on Saturday amid the ongoing CJP protest at Jantar Mantar over the NEET paper leak. The DMRC said 18 stations will remain closed from 7.30 am until further orders, while Airport Express services will be restricted. Commuters have criticised the repeated closures and disruption caused by the security measures.

title: From selling vegetables to e-rickshaw driver: Bihar's Jhand is now India's first CWG 2026 medallist
content: Bihar's Jhandu Kumar won India's first para powerlifting medal at the 2026 Commonwealth Games, claiming bronze in Glasgow after years of struggle. A former e-rickshaw driver who overcame financial hardship and polio, he lifted 190kg to reach the podium. "I feel as if I'm flying," Jhandu said, thanking his family, coaches, TOPS and SAI for their support.

title: US updates list of H-1B disqualified firms; names these 4 as 'willful violators'
content: The US Department of Labor has updated its list of H-1B visa program violators. Four companies are now temporarily barred from filing H-1B petitions. GowraTech, LLC and Renotek Group LLC face debarment until 2027. Seeloz, Inc. and Sherwood Academy are barred until 2028. This action affects employers found to be willful violators of program rules.

title: 'That's the world we live in': Head breaks silence on wife's abuse after Kohli row
content: Travis Head dismissed rumours of a feud with Virat Kohli following their IPL 2026 handshake controversy, saying there was "nothing to patch over." The incident sparked online abuse directed at Head's wife, Jessica Davies, and affected their family. Head praised his wife for handling the situation with grace, adding that public scrutiny is part of professional sport.

title: US to top universities: Scientists can 'help' America beat China more than you
content: The US government plans to fund individual scientists directly, moving away from large institutions. This strategic shift aims to accelerate technological discovery and maintain American leadership in science. Federal agencies are tasked with submitting action plans within ninety days for implementation. The report emphasizes revitalizing science and technology through AI and new research organizations. This initiative seeks to ensure scientific advancements benefit all Americans across the nation.

title: Antarctic ice loss can guide sea-level planning, but only till mid-century
content: Governments need to proactively address rising sea levels expected within the next thirty to fifty years. Recent data on Antarctic ice loss provides a sound basis for this timeframe. Beyond this period, projections may grow less reliable as melting ice accelerates. This crucial window facilitates necessary improvements to monitoring systems and coastal defenses, particularly for Pacific island nations relying on timely information for critical adaptation strategies.

title: SK chairman Chey Tae-won ordered to pay ex-wife $644m in divorce case
content: A South Korean appeals court on Friday ordered SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won to pay his former wife, Roh Soh-yeong, 944 billion won (about $644 million) in cash as part of their long-running divorce property settlement, while reaffirming that Chey's SK shares formed part of the couple's marital assets.

title: NY mayor hires Lina Khan who went after Amazon, Meta and Google in her days as FTC head
content: New York City mayor Zohran Mamdani has roped in Lina Khan to lead the board of directors for the New York City Economic Development Corporation (EDC). The former chair of the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) known for her aggressive antitrust lawsuits against Big Tech. According to Business Insider, Mamdani called the duo a “dream team” and framed the appointments as a strategic effort to pair urban business growth with his progressive affordability agenda.

title: CWG 2026: India's complete schedule, timings and medal events on Day 3
content: It is expected to be a relatively quiet day for India in terms of medal chances, with no confirmed medal events involving Indian athletes unless they qualify for the finals in artistic gymnastics and swimming.

title: 'Jana Nayagan' BO day 2: Vijay's film collection drops 50.5%
content: Thalapathy Vijay's 'Jana Nayagan' saw a noticeable collection drop on its second day.  The film still managed to cross the ₹50 crore India net milestone.  Worldwide gross collections for the movie have now surpassed ₹112 crore.  The Tamil version continues to dominate the film's overall earnings significantly.  Tamil Nadu remains the biggest market contributing substantially to its box office success.

title: CWG: Jhandu Kumar wins India's first medal; day 2 brings mixed results in Glasgow
content: Jhandu Kumar opened India's medal account by winning bronze in the men's heavyweight para powerlifting event.

title: Cape Verde's WC hero Vozinha finds new club; it's not Messi's Inter Miami
content: Cape Verde goalkeeper Vozinha has joined Colo Colo on a free transfer, ending speculation over a move to Lionel Messi's Inter Miami. The 40-year-old earned global recognition after starring at the World Cup, where he nearly inspired Cape Verde to a shock win over Argentina. The veteran, with 92 international caps, now begins a new chapter after leaving Chaves.

title: Trump returns to White House Correspondents' dinner months after shooting forced delay
content: President Trump attended the rescheduled White House Correspondents' Association dinner.  This event followed a shooting incident outside the original venue in April.  The president addressed journalists from major news organizations after months of media clashes.  The dinner celebrated press freedom and raised money for journalism scholarships.  Heightened security measures were in place for Friday's event at the Waldorf Astoria.

title: Historic! South Africa's Chad le Clos scripts Commonwealth Games record
content: South African swimmer Chad le Clos became the most decorated male athlete in Commonwealth Games history after winning his 19th medal with bronze in the men's 4x100m freestyle relay. “I shouldn’t be crying at bronze, I should be crying at gold, but honestly this means the world,” he said. The 34-year-old is also targeting more medals and hopes to compete at the 2028 Olympics.

title: How Serena Williams overcame poverty to become a tennis icon
content: Serena Williams grew up in a family that struggled financially but never gave up on their dream. Guided by her parents, Richard Williams and Oracene Price, she trained on public courts with limited resources before becoming one of tennis' greatest champions. Her journey from humble beginnings to 23 Grand Slam singles titles remains an inspiring story of resilience, sacrifice and unwavering family support.

title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes turned family pain into a heartfelt mission
content: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes attended a back-to-school event with FARE just before Chiefs training camp, continuing their advocacy for food allergy awareness. The couple's mission comes from personal experience after their children, Sterling and Bronze, were diagnosed with food allergies. Brittany has previously shared the frightening details of Bronze's severe allergic reaction and how it inspired the family to help others. Here's how Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes are using their platform to support parents and create safer environments for children with food allergies.

title: How Patrick Mahomes turned family support into NFL greatness
content: Patrick Mahomes says his greatest strength is not just football but the support of his family. From overcoming injuries to balancing life as a husband and father, he credits Brittany Mahomes and their children for keeping him grounded. His emotional words and never-give-up mindset show that resilience, patience and love have shaped both his life and his legendary NFL career.

title: Setback for Trump: US appeals court refuses to revive $100,000 H-1B visa fee
content: A federal appeals court refused to lift a ruling blocking a $100,000 H-1B visa fee. The court left in place a decision finding the fee unlawful while the government challenges it. Democratic attorneys general argued the administration created a new tax without congressional approval. A district judge agreed, ruling the fee exceeded executive branch authority. The appellate panel said the government had not shown it was likely to prevail.

title: 12.5% to 10%: Why Trump admin imposed reduced tariff rate on India & what it means
content: US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer announced the revised tariffs on 60 economies on Thursday, one day before the expiry of the temporary additional 10% duties that had been imposed on imports from all countries.

title: Why was Tony Romo arrested? Former Cowboys star faces unexpected legal trouble in Wisconsin
content: Tony Romo was arrested in Milwaukee on suspicion of driving under the influence after deputies stopped his vehicle on Interstate 43. The former Dallas Cowboys quarterback was booked and later released, with a court appearance set for September 21. Officials have not released toxicology results or explained why the traffic stop happened. CBS declined to comment.

title: Grain, not guns: MEA rejects Russia's claim on deadly ship attack that killed 4 Indians
content: India's Ministry of External Affairs stated the MV Golden Leo carried grain, not weapons. This contradicts Russia's assertion regarding the ship's cargo and its attack. The vessel's tragic incident resulted in the deaths of four Indian seafarers. India reiterated its concerns to Russia's foreign minister during a recent meeting. Attacks on commercial shipping and seafarers are unacceptable under any circumstances.

title: Paramount delays $81 billion Warner buyout amid legal challenge from 12 states
content: Paramount agreed to delay its Warner Bros. Discovery acquisition until at least 2027.  This postponement follows a court order pausing the merger process.  A coalition of states filed a lawsuit seeking to block the proposed deal.  They argue the merger would substantially lessen competition in Hollywood.  Paramount views this as a win, allowing a trial based on evidence.

title: Mike Tyson opens up about his painful childhood and mother
content: The boxing legend Mike Tyson had a complicated relationship with his mother and has often spoken about how it fuelled him to be successful.

title: Why world is coming to India for medical treatment — and not just because it is cheaper
content: India's medical tourism market is experiencing significant growth, projected to reach $16.2 billion by 2030. Patients are increasingly choosing India for its affordable and high-quality medical treatments. Digital advancements and government initiatives are further enhancing the medical travel ecosystem. International patients praise the convenience, speed, and professional care received in India. Continued collaboration will solidify India's position as a global medical destination.

title: Why IOC won't investigate Infantino over Trump's role in Balogun red-card controversy
content: The International Olympic Committee will not investigate FIFA president Gianni Infantino.  This decision stems from a complaint regarding Folarin Balogun's World Cup suspension reversal.  The IOC stated it lacks jurisdiction over FIFA's internal governance matters.  Norway's Football Federation will consider filing its own ethics complaint against Infantino.  FIFA has not yet commented on the ethics complaints or its decision.

title: How LeBron James sacrificed $50m to chase one final NBA dream
content: LeBron James chose purpose over pay by leaving behind a salary of more than $50 million to join the Philadelphia 76ers on a veteran-minimum contract. After nearly retiring, he realised his passion for basketball was still alive. Now entering his record-breaking 24th NBA season, LeBron is chasing one final championship and proving that sacrifice can matter more than money.

title: Jay-Z moves to block $119k debt from being erased in alleged son’s bankruptcy case: Report
content: Jay-Z has filed fresh legal documents seeking to prevent a $119,000 judgment against Lillie Coley, the godmother of Rymir Satterthwaite, from being discharged through bankruptcy. The rapper filed the request as part of Coley's ongoing bankruptcy proceedings, arguing that the debt should remain enforceable because it arose from conduct involving fraud and harassment rather than an ordinary financial obligation.

title: Erling Haaland's inspiring journey from setbacks to football greatness
content: The rise of Erling Haaland to football superstardom is more than just natural talent. His journey is a testament to years of perseverance, family support, mental resilience, and a relentless belief in self-improvement. As the Manchester City striker continues to lead Norway on football’s biggest stages, his emotional story has valuable lessons about determination, humility and turning setbacks into lasting success.

title: Fast-track courts in slow lane now, backlog 2.5 lakh cases
content: fast-track special courts are meant to complete trials within a year of taking cognisance of offences related to rape and Pocso Act . in 2025, more than 1.4 lakh cases were registered, only 66,500 were disposed of . trend has been similar over the last three years, with the total pendency at over 2 lakh .
